title: Apply to become an approved vendor at the Alemany Flea Market

paragraphs: Step-by-step
Register to become an approved vendor.
At the Alemany Flea Market, you can sell antiques, vintage goods, handmade crafts and collectables. Follow the process below to become a vendor.

sections.heading: Check the list of what you’re allowed to sell
paragraphs: Learn what you can sell at the Alemany Flea Market and what you can’t.

sections.heading: Make sure you have a valid ID
paragraphs: Varies
You need to have one of the following:
California driver’s license
California Identification Card
Other government ID
Get a California ID

sections.heading: Get a California Seller’s Permit
paragraphs: If you don’t already have a California seller’s permit, you need one.
You can sell twice in a calendar year without a seller's permit
Apply for a seller's permit

sections.heading: Read the rules
paragraphs: Before you can become a vendor, you need to review the market rules.
Read the Alemany Flea Market Rules and Regulations

sections.heading: Register A Business in San Francisco
paragraphs: If applicable based on the information in the Permission to Sell section of the Alemany Flea Market Rules and Regulations, register your business in San Francisco.
San Francisco Business Registration

sections.heading: Fill out the 2 forms
paragraphs: Print, fill out, and sign these forms:
Alemany Flea Market agreement to comply with the rules
Alemany Flea Market Vendor Application
Note that you'll need to list all the goods you plan to sell on the vendor application.

sections.heading: Submit your application
paragraphs: Your application has to include:
A copy of your legal ID
A copy of your California seller’s permit
The 2 forms above
Sample pictures of items that will be sold
Please scan and email your application to alemany.market@sfgov.org

sections.heading: Prepare to sell goods at the Farmers Market
paragraphs: Once you’re approved to sell, you can start planning for market day.
Sell goods at the Alemany Flea Market

sections.heading: Appeal our decision if you’re not approved
paragraphs: If we didn't accept your application, you can ask us to reconsider.
Appeal an Alemany Flea Market vendor decision
